tables.name: ac_fault_profiles
tables.purpose: 版本化故障配置；T07实现注入

tables.name: ac_knowledge_documents
tables.purpose: 有来源与适用条件的不可变规则修订

constraints.name: ck_knowledge_validity
constraints.sql: valid_to IS NULL OR valid_from IS NULL OR valid_to > valid_from

tables.name: sb_rooms
tables.purpose: 按scope隔离的场地和开放时间

tables.name: ac_targets
tables.purpose: 被测对象登记，不表示已实现Agent

tables.name: ac_test_cases
tables.purpose: 用例修订、家族/划分、审核和独立预期

constraints.name: ck_case_approval_audit
constraints.sql: review_status <> 'approved' OR (reviewer_id IS NOT NULL AND reviewed_at IS NOT NULL)

tables.name: sb_booking_drafts
tables.purpose: 绑定身份/场地/参数哈希的确认草稿

tables.name: ac_target_versions
tables.purpose: 不可变对象/模型/工具/知识配置修订

tables.name: sb_bookings
tables.purpose: 预约事实、稳定幂等键和草稿唯一性

tables.name: ac_test_runs
tables.purpose: 冻结运行清单与可变运行状态

tables.name: sb_booking_slots
tables.purpose: 按scope/场地/30分钟占用片防冲突

constraints.name: ck_slot_alignment
constraints.sql: MINUTE(slot_start) IN (0,30) AND SECOND(slot_start)=0 AND MICROSECOND(slot_start)=0

tables.name: ac_artifacts
tables.purpose: 不可变清单；运行归属run，T11—T13生成/校准/冻结归属owner，二者互斥

constraints.name: ck_artifact_owner
constraints.sql: (run_id IS NOT NULL AND owner_id IS NULL) OR (run_id IS NULL AND owner_id IS NOT NULL AND kind IN ('casegen_request','casegen_result','casegen_call','case_review','judge_request','judge_result','judge_call','judge_label','judge_review','dataset_manifest'))

tables.name: ac_test_executions
tables.purpose: 独立计划执行、scope/session、恢复attempt及租约

constraints.name: ck_execution_outcome
constraints.sql: task_outcome IS NULL OR task_outcome IN ('fulfilled','safely_degraded','unknown','not_fulfilled')

tables.name: ac_assertion_results
tables.purpose: 追加式规则/AI/人工判定；T08实现断言引擎

tables.name: ac_defects
tables.purpose: 缺陷归并与人工复核，不覆盖原始判定

tables.name: ac_trace_events
tables.purpose: T06追加式类型化事件、真实run归属与事务提交序列
